notes.note: Extension users now see a more prominent message when an extension has an update pending that requires approval for new permissions or data collection consent.
Added three new search widget options. You can now set a search bar with image, private and voice search to easily search from your phone's home screen.

Android Automotive: You can now download the Firefox app directly from Google Play in [cars with Google built-in][1]. Whether you are waiting for your kid at school pick-up, charging your EV between long drives, or taking a breather in the parking lot before braving the holiday shopping frenzy, you can use Firefox right from your parked car’s dashboard. Less squinting at a mobile screen; more getting stuff done.

The best part? [Our commitment to privacy][2] comes along for the ride. Firefox is built on the principle that not even Mozilla should know which websites you visit or what you do there, and your personal data will never be shared with the car manufacturer.


  [1]: https://built-in.google/cars/#explore-cars
  [2]: https://www.mozilla.org/privacy/firefox/

Default homepage shortcuts other than Google now make room for the sites visited most often, more regions get their own set of default shortcuts, and there is no longer a limit on how many shortcuts can be added.
Fixed pages that request landscape orientation being saved as shrunken portrait pages when printing or saving to PDF.
Improved performance on some devices for web pages that use blur and similar effects behind page elements.
